sections.title: Section 1: Budget Accommodation In Queenstown, New Zealand
sections.html:
dormitory

(noun). Kí túc xá,Nhà ở tập thể

University students can live in a dormitory inside the school

suppose

(verb). Cho là; tin rằng; nghĩ rằng

Dan didn't answer his phone, so I suppose (that) he's busy.

sundeck

(noun). sân thượng để tắm nắng

They are sitting on the sundeck

alpine

(adjective). núi cao, ở núi cao

The alpine region is colder than in the city

quote

(verb). Định giá, đặt giá

The architect has quoted £90,000 to build a house.

trek

(verb). Đi bộ vất vả

We spent a day trekking through forests

aeroplane

(noun). Máy bay, tàu bay

I see an aeroplane flying in the sky

availability

(noun). Tính sẵn sàng để dùng, tính có thể dùng được

The availability of water is decreasing

elastic rope

(noun). dây đàn hồi, dây chun

Elastic ropes on two sides of the mask

tie

(verb). Buộc, cột, trói

The kid ties her shoes

raft

(noun). cái bè, cái mảng (bằng gỗ, nứa.. thay thế cho thuyền bè); bè gỗ

They are standing on the raft to cross the river

rubber

(noun). Cao su

Tires are made from rubber

rapid

(adjective). Nhanh, nhanh chóng, mau lẹ

A rapid increase

narrow

(adjective). Hẹp, chật hẹp, eo hẹp

A narrow road

tunnel

(noun). Đường hầm

The train is going into a tunnel

whiz

(verb). Rít, vèo

The police car is whizzing around to catch the robber

touristy

(adjective). đầy khách du lịch,

Las Vegas has become a touristy city

canyon

(noun). Hẻm núi

A beautiful canyon

skillful

(adjective). khéo léo

He is a skillful chef, he can cook many dishes

give a go.

(verb). thử điều gì

He has never tried this before but he will give it a go

mind

(verb). Quan tâm, bận tâm

He doesn't mind the sun, he just hates the heat

commercial

(adjective). thuộc) buôn bán; (thuộc) thương mại; (thuộc) thương nghiệp

The movie was a commercial success, it made a lot of money

apparent

(adjective). Rõ ràng, bày tỏ ra ngoài, thấy rõ ra ngoài

His happiness was apparent to everyone.

wilderness

(noun). Vùng hoang vu, vùng hoang dã

Wolves live in the wilderness

pack

(verb). sắp xếp hành lý

She packs her things in a box to move to a new house

ankle

(noun). Mắt cá chân

His ankle is in pain

route

realistic

complex

a complicated game

She is an assertive person because she is always confident

segregation

(noun). Sự tách riêng, sự chia tách, sự phân biệt; sự bị tách riêng, sự bị chia tách, sự bị phân biệt

There was a school segregation between black and white people

disruption

(noun). Sự đập gãy, sự đập vỡ, sự phá vỡ; sự gẫy vỡ

The accident causes traffic disruption

reckon

(verb). đoán, nghĩ, tin rằng

I reckon it's going to rain.

practical

(adjective). Thiết thực, có ích, mang tính thực tế

This is a pratical way of learning science

sections.title: Section 3: Presentationabout The Digital Divide
sections.html:
criteria

(noun). các tiêu chuẩn

You IELTS band score will be marked based on 4 criteria

content

(noun). Nội dung

The content of the book was boring

technique

(noun). Kỹ xảo, Kỹ thuật, phương pháp

The violinist’s technique was amazing

structure

(noun). Kết cấu, cấu trúc

This is a structure of a sentence

feature

(noun). Nét đặc biệt, điểm đặc trưng

Iphone has many new features

define

(verb). Định nghĩa (một từ...) Định rõ, vạch rõ

No one can define love

identify

(verb). to recognize someone or something and say or prove who or what that person or thing is

I can identify the stars

evaluate

(verb). đánh giá, ước lượng

They evaluate the employee performance

peer

(noun). Người cùng địa vị, người ngang hàng, người tương đương

Female workers can be as intelligent as their male peers

signpost

(verb). chỉ dẫn

He uses signposting language in his presentation to introduce new idea

conflict

(verb). Xung đột, va chạm

The two groups conflict because they have different opinions

visual

(adjective). thị giác, có liên quan đến thị giác;

He is doing a visual ability test

analysis

(noun). sự phân tích, phép phân tích

His data analysis is colourful

wide-ranging.

(adjective). rộng khắp

A wide ranging project which included many countries

manage to

(verb). Đạt kết quả, đạt mục đích, xoay sở được, tìm được các

They manage to win in a short amount of time

impress

(verb). Gây ấn tượng; làm cảm động, làm cảm kích

His strength didn't impress her

methodology

(noun). Hệ phương pháp Phương pháp luận

They use 4 different methodologies to carry out the research

pointer

(noun). lời khuyên, lời gợi ý

They give young people useful pointers

sudden

(adjective). bất ngờ,đột ngột

He was walking but suddenly fell

praise

(verb). Khen ngợi, ca ngợi, tán dương

The employee was praised for her hard work

extend

(verb). Kéo dài (thời hạn...), gia hạn, mở rộng

We have plans to extend our house

round it off

(verb). Quy lại, tóm lại

We round the dinner off with a great dessert

strong point

(noun). điểm mạnh

English is not her strong point

limitation

(noun). Sự hạn chế, sự hạn định, sự giới hạn

The lack of confidence can be a big limitation

flesh out

(verb). Thêm thông tin hoặc chi tiết.

She tries to flesh out her idea

sections.title: Section 4: The Problems That Have Resulted From The Rapid Growth Of Cities
sections.html:
dormitory

(noun). Kí túc xá,Nhà ở tập thể

University students can live in a dormitory inside the school

suppose

(verb). Cho là; tin rằng; nghĩ rằng

Dan didn't answer his phone, so I suppose (that) he's busy.

sundeck

(noun). sân thượng để tắm nắng

They are sitting on the sundeck

alpine

(adjective). núi cao, ở núi cao

The alpine region is colder than in the city

quote

(verb). Định giá, đặt giá

The architect has quoted £90,000 to build a house.

trek

(verb). Đi bộ vất vả

We spent a day trekking through forests

aeroplane

(noun). Máy bay, tàu bay

I see an aeroplane flying in the sky

availability

(noun). Tính sẵn sàng để dùng, tính có thể dùng được

The availability of water is decreasing

elastic rope

(noun). dây đàn hồi, dây chun

Elastic ropes on two sides of the mask

tie

(verb). Buộc, cột, trói

The kid ties her shoes

raft

(noun). cái bè, cái mảng (bằng gỗ, nứa.. thay thế cho thuyền bè); bè gỗ

They are standing on the raft to cross the river

rubber

(noun). Cao su

Tires are made from rubber

rapid

(adjective). Nhanh, nhanh chóng, mau lẹ

A rapid increase

narrow

(adjective). Hẹp, chật hẹp, eo hẹp

A narrow road

tunnel

(noun). Đường hầm

The train is going into a tunnel

whiz

(verb). Rít, vèo

The police car is whizzing around to catch the robber

touristy

(adjective). đầy khách du lịch,

Las Vegas has become a touristy city

canyon

(noun). Hẻm núi

A beautiful canyon

skillful

(adjective). khéo léo

He is a skillful chef, he can cook many dishes

give a go.

(verb). thử điều gì

He has never tried this before but he will give it a go

mind

(verb). Quan tâm, bận tâm

He doesn't mind the sun, he just hates the heat

commercial

(adjective). thuộc) buôn bán; (thuộc) thương mại; (thuộc) thương nghiệp

The movie was a commercial success, it made a lot of money

apparent

(adjective). Rõ ràng, bày tỏ ra ngoài, thấy rõ ra ngoài

His happiness was apparent to everyone.

wilderness

(noun). Vùng hoang vu, vùng hoang dã

Wolves live in the wilderness

pack

(verb). sắp xếp hành lý

She packs her things in a box to move to a new house

ankle

(noun). Mắt cá chân

His ankle is in pain
